question: Estimate the number of samosas sold at Indian railway stations every day.
idealClarificationQuestions: All railway stations across India? Yes.
Samosa specifically (excluding kachori, vada pav, dhokla)? Yes — samosa only.
All vendors: IRCTC catering + platform stalls + vendor walks? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Number of stations × avg samosa sales per station per day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Mega stations (Howrah, NDLS, CSMT, etc.): ~50; ~3,000 samosas/day each = 150K.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total: ~700,000 samosas/day at and around railways.

calculationFlow: - Mega stations (Howrah, NDLS, CSMT, etc.): ~50; ~3,000 samosas/day each = 150K.
Add in-train pantry car samosas: ~200 trains × ~150 samosas = 30K.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total: ~700,000 samosas/day at and around railways.
